citations.claim: first no_nan violation: body 1 hover vehicle position/velocity is non-finite at step 1228
one step before, body 1 sits exactly on its target waypoint x=7.13516 y=9.59857
body 1 speed is essentially zero at step 1227, so distance to waypoint is zero

counterfactual.change: changed controller noise from 0 to 0.01; sensor noise prevents exact zero distance-to-waypoint so no 0/0 normalization occurs

explanation: Body 1 (controller-driven hover vehicle) reaches its waypoint exactly at step 1227 (position equals waypoint 7.13516,9.59857 with ~0 speed). On the next update the controller must compute a direction to the target as (target-pos)/dist with dist=0, i.e. 0/0=NaN, producing a NaN force that integrates to NaN position/velocity (and NaN energy/work) at step 1228. Adding tiny sensor noise avoids the exact-zero distance and removes the failure.
vision_note: The red body sits almost motionless near the top across steps 1225 to 1227. At step 1228 it disappears entirely, revealing a green waypoint cross at its former position while the blue bodies below shift.
